title: From News to Forecast: Integrating Event Analysis in LLM-Based Time Series Forecasting with Reflection

claim.summary: News-to-forecast aligns selected event news with time-series histories, fine-tunes a forecasting LLM and refines news-selection logic using validation forecast errors.

modules.name: News-conditioned forecasting LoRA
modules.scope_reason: Supervised instruction tuning changes model parameters using textualized temporal/news input-output pairs.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "We employ a supervised instruction tuning"

modules.name: Validation-guided news selection refinement
modules.scope_reason: Prediction errors identify overlooked event news and update selection logic used to prepare forecasting training pairs.
evidence_locators: PDF p.7; passage beginning "For the evaluation agent"
